missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Палец' is the nominative subject of 'болит'. The possession frame 'у меня' shows whose finger hurts. A core complaint pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Палец' is the accusative direct object of 'порезал'; for this inanimate masculine noun the accusative looks like the nominative. 'Ножом' is the instrumental tool.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На пальце' uses the prepositional form 'пальце' after 'на' to place the cut. Note the fleeting vowel: the 'е' of 'палец' drops, giving 'пальце'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Пальца' is the genitive after negated 'не чувствую'. The fleeting vowel drops in the genitive too. Useful for describing numbness.
Strategic focus: Dative of measure. 'По пальцу' uses the dative 'пальцу' after 'по' to size the ring to the finger. 'Ему' is the dative experiencer. A practical fitting phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Пальцем' is the instrumental form showing what she pointed with. The fleeting vowel drops before the ending. A natural gesture description.

missions.phrase: У него десять пальцев на руках.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. 'Пальцев' is the genitive plural required by 'десять'. 'На руках' is prepositional plural. A clear counting model.

missions.phrase: У ребёнка пальцы все в краске.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пальцы' is the nominative plural subject of the description. 'В краске' is prepositional, and 'все' covers them all. Good for everyday mess.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'На пальцах' uses the prepositional plural 'пальцах' after 'на'. 'Деньги' is the accusative object. A vivid idiom for counting.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Пальцами' is the instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Нитка' is the nominative subject of 'застряла'. A precise spatial description.
